Bishnupriya Manipuri type project / Version 1.0

Mekholi family

Designer: Surajit Singha Sisir · Developer: Ningshing Che

Experimental family. Eighteen static styles, mechanically weighted from the Kalpurush-derived Regular. “Italic” means a 12° slanted upright, not a newly drawn true italic. Optical refinement, native-language approval and production testing remain pending.

Try a sample

Paste native-language text for review. Unsupported characters may fall back to another browser font; this editor is not a coverage validator.
